description: Standard benchmark suite — 20 scenarios across 4 domains. v2-portable.

scenarios.name: Check deployment status
scenarios.goal: Check the deployment status of the payment service

tools.rich_description: check_deployment_status (devops). Check deployment status and health. effects: returns status, version, health
check_logs (devops). Query service logs. effects: returns recent log entries
